Class DinosaurDatabase

java.lang.Object
DinosaurDatabase
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class DinosaurDatabase extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Edgar Lopez CEN 3024C - Software Developement 1 November 16, 2026 DinosaurDatabase.java Manages the SQLite database for the Dinosaur Data Management System. Establishes database connections and provides operations for creating, adding, retrieving, searching, and removing dinosaur records. This class provides persistent storage for the dinosaur information managed by the application.

    • searchDinosaurs

      public List<Dinosaur> searchDinosaurs(String attribute, String value)
      Searches dinosaur records using an exact attribute match. Text searches ignore capitalization, while size searches use an exact numeric comparison.
      Parameters:
      attribute - the attribute to search
      value - the value to search for
      Returns:
      a list of matching dinosaurs, or an empty list if the search criteria are invalid or no matches are found
